# RC39 — Keyboard line-comment toggle

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc c /` / `code.toggle-line-comment` / `Toggle Line Comment`.
- The command comments or uncomments the current line or selected line range as one dirty undoable edit.
- Blank lines in the affected range are preserved.
- The toggle comments nonblank lines when any affected nonblank line is currently uncommented; it uncomments when every affected nonblank line already has the file's line marker.
- Supported line markers:
  - `//` for Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, C-like, Swift, JSON/JSONC, and CSS-family files.
  - `#` for Python, Ruby, shell, TOML, and YAML files.
  - `--` for SQL and Lua files.
- Unsupported block-comment-oriented or plain buffers report a visible no-marker status instead of guessing.
- The Code namespace hint, command palette, keymap reference, README, and iPad QA matrix now expose the route.
